overloadPatches.semanticRole: Gets a column range from the table intersecting a range, element, or 4D Write Pro document; returns Null if no such intersection exists.

discriminatedBy.note: single Object arg resolved as a range/element/document rather than a raw table reference

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Gets a column range from a table, addressed by table reference and explicit start column (with optional column count, defaulting to a single column).

discriminatedBy.note: 2-3 arg form addressing a table by reference plus explicit column index

constraints: If numCols is omitted, only the single startCol column is returned.
If startCol+numCols exceeds the number of columns in tableRef, or startCol is greater than the number of columns, the returned range is clamped to the maximum possible columns.
